raw: [animtext(id = "at1", name = "group_location_stamp", style="avg_both", pos = "-400,-200", block = false)]<p=1>Streets of Norport</><p=2>December 26th, 1098, 5:23 P.M.</>
content: <p=1>Streets of Norport</><p=2>December 26th, 1098, 5:23 P.M.</>

raw: [name="Indra"]How'd things go on your end, Dagda?
speaker: Indra
content: How'd things go on your end, Dagda?

raw: [name="Dagda"]Mr. Lane's still alive, but he's got a busted leg. His sworn brother didn't make it, though. I tried asking some old friends...
speaker: Dagda
content: Mr. Lane's still alive, but he's got a busted leg. His sworn brother didn't make it, though. I tried asking some old friends...

raw: [name="Dagda"]None of them know when that brother passed away exactly. Might've been when trying to escape Norport, might've been some Sarkaz at the end of their tether during the allied counterattack...
speaker: Dagda
content: None of them know when that brother passed away exactly. Might've been when trying to escape Norport, might've been some Sarkaz at the end of their tether during the allied counterattack...

raw: [name="Indra"]Did you manage to see Mr. Lane himself?
speaker: Indra
content: Did you manage to see Mr. Lane himself?

raw: [name="Dagda"]I did. He works at the port now. He didn't bring up the old days, and he avoided talking about his crew.
speaker: Dagda
content: I did. He works at the port now. He didn't bring up the old days, and he avoided talking about his crew.

raw: [name="Dagda"]But he thinks that now, he's living a good life.
speaker: Dagda
content: But he thinks that now, he's living a good life.

speaker: Indra
content: Bloody hell.

raw: [name="Indra"]I strolled around one of the factories we used to look after. It's full of little punks now. None of those youngsters have even heard of us Glasgow Gang.
speaker: Indra
content: I strolled around one of the factories we used to look after. It's full of little punks now. None of those youngsters have even heard of us Glasgow Gang.

raw: [name="Indra"]That pack of brats deserves a right trashing!
speaker: Indra
content: That pack of brats deserves a right trashing!

raw: [name="Dagda"]Did you swing by the old restaurant we always went to?
speaker: Dagda
content: Did you swing by the old restaurant we always went to?

raw: [name="Indra"]Torn down. Parliament sent some men over to get in touch with all the old shopkeeps. Anything so run-down it couldn't be fixed up, and whose owner was missing, was slated to be torn down and rebuilt.
speaker: Indra
content: Torn down. Parliament sent some men over to get in touch with all the old shopkeeps. Anything so run-down it couldn't be fixed up, and whose owner was missing, was slated to be torn down and rebuilt.

raw: [name="Indra"]The pub on Sunset Street, Paul's Bar, the magazine stall that runt from Kazimierz ran... They're all gone.
speaker: Indra
content: The pub on Sunset Street, Paul's Bar, the magazine stall that runt from Kazimierz ran... They're all gone.

speaker: Dagda
content: Hannah...

raw: [name="Indra"]I checked out that public cemetery they were talking about too. I couldn't find McClaren, or—
speaker: Indra
content: I checked out that public cemetery they were talking about too. I couldn't find McClaren, or—

raw: [name="Indra"](Choking back tears) Dammit, why don't these graves have names on them?
speaker: Indra
content: (Choking back tears) Dammit, why don't these graves have names on them?

raw: [name="Indra"]Stuff me, can't believe you caught me crying.
speaker: Indra
content: Stuff me, can't believe you caught me crying.

raw: [name="Indra"]Let's head home already. Don't wanna leave Morgan waiting.
speaker: Indra
content: Let's head home already. Don't wanna leave Morgan waiting.

raw: [name="Morgan"]I thought... I thought the gym was going to be a rougher sight.
speaker: Morgan
content: I thought... I thought the gym was going to be a rougher sight.

speaker: Morgan
content: Thank you.

raw: [name="Morgan"]Looks to me like you've been taking care of the place this whole time.
speaker: Morgan
content: Looks to me like you've been taking care of the place this whole time.

raw: [name="Cador"]I thought if you were still alive, you'd be coming back sooner or later. Doesn't matter how you look at it, I'm still part of the Glasgow Gang.
speaker: Cador
content: I thought if you were still alive, you'd be coming back sooner or later. Doesn't matter how you look at it, I'm still part of the Glasgow Gang.

raw: [name="Morgan"]You didn't get on Duke Windermere's ship with us back then—
speaker: Morgan
content: You didn't get on Duke Windermere's ship with us back then—

raw: [name="Cador"]I wasn't so far gone that I needed saving by the dukes.
speaker: Cador
content: I wasn't so far gone that I needed saving by the dukes.

raw: [name="Cador"]But... I gotta admit, I was being a right fool back then. After all that, I took some of the crew out to fight some devils hanging around Norport.
speaker: Cador
content: But... I gotta admit, I was being a right fool back then. After all that, I took some of the crew out to fight some devils hanging around Norport.

raw: [name="Cador"]I ended up hearing about the Exemplars from them.
speaker: Cador
content: I ended up hearing about the Exemplars from them.

raw: [name="Cador"]You pulled off some crazy stunts I could never dream of. An army, hah... When the battle outside was in total chaos, some of the gang helped out on the front line with me.
speaker: Cador
content: You pulled off some crazy stunts I could never dream of. An army, hah... When the battle outside was in total chaos, some of the gang helped out on the front line with me.

raw: [name="Cador"]But there wasn't much we could do. All I got in the end were a few cuts and bruises—
speaker: Cador
content: But there wasn't much we could do. All I got in the end were a few cuts and bruises—

speaker: Morgan
content: You're Infected too?

raw: [name="Cador"]Yep. Heard the same happened to Indra after she took a bad scrape on the battlefield not too long ago.
speaker: Cador
content: Yep. Heard the same happened to Indra after she took a bad scrape on the battlefield not too long ago.

raw: [name="Cador"]She's real lucky she had friends like you there with her.
speaker: Cador
content: She's real lucky she had friends like you there with her.

raw: Morgan stares blankly ahead. She'd never considered that problem. Not even Indra herself had.
content: Morgan stares blankly ahead. She'd never considered that problem. Not even Indra herself had.

raw: [name="Morgan"]No, no, that ain't right. Why do I feel all funny hearing you say that? Though I gotta admit I'm not sure what's not right about what you said.
speaker: Morgan
content: No, no, that ain't right. Why do I feel all funny hearing you say that? Though I gotta admit I'm not sure what's not right about what you said.

raw: [name="Cador"]Hah, whatever you say. Anyway, if you ever get the chance, tell Siege I said sorry.
speaker: Cador
content: Hah, whatever you say. Anyway, if you ever get the chance, tell Siege I said sorry.

raw: [name="Morgan"]If you stick around you can tell her yourself.
speaker: Morgan
content: If you stick around you can tell her yourself.

raw: [name="Cador"]My Glasgow Gang's long gone. Since you're coming back, it's only right that I head out.
speaker: Cador
content: My Glasgow Gang's long gone. Since you're coming back, it's only right that I head out.

raw: [name="Cador"]Did Delphine not come back with you?
speaker: Cador
content: Did Delphine not come back with you?

speaker: Morgan
content: She's standing by Vina's side.

raw: [name="Cador"]Hah, sounds like you lot had a squabble too. I heard about her mum from a broadcast... Doesn't matter who she might be, at least she's got some nerve.
speaker: Cador
content: Hah, sounds like you lot had a squabble too. I heard about her mum from a broadcast... Doesn't matter who she might be, at least she's got some nerve.

speaker: Morgan
content: Where you headed off to next?

raw: [name="Cador"]Norport needs more hands to rebuild it, and the port's busy shuttling in goods from outside all day every day. Me and my crew are gonna keep an eye on it.
speaker: Cador
content: Norport needs more hands to rebuild it, and the port's busy shuttling in goods from outside all day every day. Me and my crew are gonna keep an eye on it.

raw: [name="Cador"]And then... And then I'll head into Central to bash in some merchant bastard's head—Err...
speaker: Cador
content: And then... And then I'll head into Central to bash in some merchant bastard's head—Err...

raw: [name="Cador"]That's only a maybe. Norport's changed, Morgan.
speaker: Cador
content: That's only a maybe. Norport's changed, Morgan.

raw: [name="Cador"]The folks I know are gone, and the shops too. There's some new gang of brats that's popped up. Don't know their arse from their elbow yet they're still trying to fight for dominance...
speaker: Cador
content: The folks I know are gone, and the shops too. There's some new gang of brats that's popped up. Don't know their arse from their elbow yet they're still trying to fight for dominance...

raw: [name="Cador"]Anyway, I'm giving the gym back to you lot.
speaker: Cador
content: Anyway, I'm giving the gym back to you lot.

raw: [name="Cador"]Parliament talked a big game in that broadcast of theirs. I talked it over with some of the boys. We'll wait a spell, then head over to some other dukedom to see what's what.
speaker: Cador
content: Parliament talked a big game in that broadcast of theirs. I talked it over with some of the boys. We'll wait a spell, then head over to some other dukedom to see what's what.

speaker: Cador
content: We'll find a new turf.

raw: [name="Cador"]A new turf, a new beginning. I'll need some time to forget a few things.
speaker: Cador
content: A new turf, a new beginning. I'll need some time to forget a few things.

raw: [name="Indra"]Morgan, was that Cador leaving just now?
speaker: Indra
content: Morgan, was that Cador leaving just now?

speaker: Morgan
content: Yep.

raw: [name="Morgan"]He came to say goodbye, and decided to hand this back to us while he was at it.
speaker: Morgan
content: He came to say goodbye, and decided to hand this back to us while he was at it.

raw: She pulls out a butterfly knife from her pocket. It's badly scratched, but the emblem of the Glasgow Gang can still be clearly seen.
content: She pulls out a butterfly knife from her pocket. It's badly scratched, but the emblem of the Glasgow Gang can still be clearly seen.

raw: Baird's butterfly knife. Hannah would recognize it anywhere. It was her who insisted on engraving that emblem once she beat Baird, after all.
content: Baird's butterfly knife. Hannah would recognize it anywhere. It was her who insisted on engraving that emblem once she beat Baird, after all.

raw: [name="Morgan"]Cador found it on the body of a cleaner... He couldn't find Baird herself, though.
speaker: Morgan
content: Cador found it on the body of a cleaner... He couldn't find Baird herself, though.

speaker: Indra
content: I went there too.

raw: [name="Indra"]All I found was some stuff on the wall I didn't get. It's almost all gone, what with all the rain. But I'm sure...
speaker: Indra
content: All I found was some stuff on the wall I didn't get. It's almost all gone, what with all the rain. But I'm sure...

raw: [name="Indra"]I'm sure she was there. I saw her handwriting.
speaker: Indra
content: I'm sure she was there. I saw her handwriting.

speaker: Indra
content: 'I hope so too'...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="'I hope so too.'", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: 'I hope so too.'

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nWhat did Baird hope for? We thought about it long and hard, but we were never able to make sense of it.",block = true)]
text: \nWhat did Baird hope for? We thought about it long and hard, but we were never able to make sense of it.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nHer wishes had already been washed back into Norport's soil by the rain.",block = true)]
text: \nHer wishes had already been washed back into Norport's soil by the rain.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="We decided not to dwell on it much longer.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: We decided not to dwell on it much longer.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nWe never could guess her last little secret.",block = true)]
text: \nWe never could guess her last little secret.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nShe's definitely having a good laugh at us right now.",block = true)]
text: \nShe's definitely having a good laugh at us right now.

raw: [name="Dagda"]I remember that whenever we went to the video shop, Baird hated weepy scenes about grieving the most.
speaker: Dagda
content: I remember that whenever we went to the video shop, Baird hated weepy scenes about grieving the most.

raw: [name="Morgan"]Yeah. She never thought death was worth being all that sad for.
speaker: Morgan
content: Yeah. She never thought death was worth being all that sad for.

raw: [name="Indra"]Pass the knife to me. I'll think of a way to hang it up on the wall.
speaker: Indra
content: Pass the knife to me. I'll think of a way to hang it up on the wall.

raw: [name="Morgan"]Then I'll go get some drinks. To celebrate us coming home, and a toast to Baird!
speaker: Morgan
content: Then I'll go get some drinks. To celebrate us coming home, and a toast to Baird!

speaker: Dagda
content: Should we wait for Vina?

raw: [name="Morgan"]She ain't got the time to come.
speaker: Morgan
content: She ain't got the time to come.

speaker: Indra
content: But just in case—

raw: [name="Morgan"]Then we'll hold off right before we get completely pissed, Hannah.
speaker: Morgan
content: Then we'll hold off right before we get completely pissed, Hannah.

speaker: Morgan
content: Booze waits for no man.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="That day, without having to say a word on the matter, we all drank our drinks real slow.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: That day, without having to say a word on the matter, we all drank our drinks real slow.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nWe were waiting for one more person.",block = true)]
text: \nWe were waiting for one more person.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nIt seems there was a lot of chit-chat going on that day. Not that we remember any of it after the hangover.",block = true)]
text: \nIt seems there was a lot of chit-chat going on that day. Not that we remember any of it after the hangover.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="All I remember is that Hannah and I got in a fight, and Dagda's brow got itself another scar. Why? None of us knew.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: All I remember is that Hannah and I got in a fight, and Dagda's brow got itself another scar. Why? None of us knew.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nIf Vina were there, it'll all be fine. She always stayed the most sober out of all of us, and she'd remember for us.",block = true)]
text: \nIf Vina were there, it'll all be fine. She always stayed the most sober out of all of us, and she'd remember for us.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nBut she never showed up that day.",block = true)]
text: \nBut she never showed up that day.

raw: [name="Nervous Mercenary"]I dragged the body back, Boss.
speaker: Nervous Mercenary
content: I dragged the body back, Boss.

raw: [name="Nervous Mercenary"]But... Will this really be okay? I mean, snatching away the corpse of a condemned criminal from right under Parliament's nose—
speaker: Nervous Mercenary
content: But... Will this really be okay? I mean, snatching away the corpse of a condemned criminal from right under Parliament's nose—

raw: [name="Millscar"]Did you really think you could take that away without some silent approval from above?
speaker: Millscar
content: Did you really think you could take that away without some silent approval from above?

speaker: Millscar
content: What of the Columbian?

raw: [name="Nervous Mercenary"]He's not in the best of moods... Boss, do we really need him to carry these goods? What if—
speaker: Nervous Mercenary
content: He's not in the best of moods... Boss, do we really need him to carry these goods? What if—

raw: Millscar says nothing. The mercenary sighs.
content: Millscar says nothing. The mercenary sighs.

raw: [name="Nervous Mercenary"]Alright, I get it. Look, Boss, I'm not trying to make you mad. But ever since Parliament made a move on us, everyone's been on edge.
speaker: Nervous Mercenary
content: Alright, I get it. Look, Boss, I'm not trying to make you mad. But ever since Parliament made a move on us, everyone's been on edge.

speaker: Millscar
content: It doesn't concern you lot.

speaker: Millscar
content: I'll handle the Columbian.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Eliseo. I presume I don't need to introduce myself.
speaker: Millscar
content: Eliseo. I presume I don't need to introduce myself.

speaker: Eliseo
content: Millscar. I've heard about you.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Good, no need to waste words then. I need you to see this batch of goods out of Londinium safely.
speaker: Millscar
content: Good, no need to waste words then. I need you to see this batch of goods out of Londinium safely.

raw: [name="Millscar"]You will, of course, receive payment. I can send this 'corpse' along with you.
speaker: Millscar
content: You will, of course, receive payment. I can send this 'corpse' along with you.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Leave the city, and go as far away from it as you can.
speaker: Millscar
content: Leave the city, and go as far away from it as you can.

speaker: Eliseo
content: Her name is Diane, Millscar.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Who she is isn't important to me.
speaker: Millscar
content: Who she is isn't important to me.

raw: [name="Millscar"]What's important is that she doesn't show her face again in Londinium.
speaker: Millscar
content: What's important is that she doesn't show her face again in Londinium.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]You call this payment? Making someone who just got home leave again?
speaker: Eliseo
content: You call this payment? Making someone who just got home leave again?

raw: [name="Millscar"]Eliseo, you are well aware she cannot stay in the city. As far as everyone is concerned, she is dead. Hanged from the gallows.
speaker: Millscar
content: Eliseo, you are well aware she cannot stay in the city. As far as everyone is concerned, she is dead. Hanged from the gallows.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Vina made a mistake. So long as this person is alive and within the city, sooner or later someone is going to use her as a knife to stab Vina in the back.
speaker: Millscar
content: Vina made a mistake. So long as this person is alive and within the city, sooner or later someone is going to use her as a knife to stab Vina in the back.

raw: [name="Millscar"]*sigh* She really must learn to be more decisive.
speaker: Millscar
content: *sigh* She really must learn to be more decisive.

raw: [name="Millscar"]You know the condition of her infection better than I do, Eliseo. She doesn't have long.
speaker: Millscar
content: You know the condition of her infection better than I do, Eliseo. She doesn't have long.

raw: [name="Millscar"]You're welcome to refuse, of course. But I will still help Vina settle this matter. In my own way.
speaker: Millscar
content: You're welcome to refuse, of course. But I will still help Vina settle this matter. In my own way.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]I know your story, Millscar. Or rather, Lady Allerdale Cumberland.
speaker: Eliseo
content: I know your story, Millscar. Or rather, Lady Allerdale Cumberland.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]There's a lot of versions of it out there, but they all agree you really did fit with the title of 'Cumberland the Ever on High', once upon a time.
speaker: Eliseo
content: There's a lot of versions of it out there, but they all agree you really did fit with the title of 'Cumberland the Ever on High', once upon a time.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]Fine, I'll get Diane out of here. I can take better care of her back in Columbia.
speaker: Eliseo
content: Fine, I'll get Diane out of here. I can take better care of her back in Columbia.

speaker: Eliseo
content: Happy?

raw: [name="Millscar"]You're a good man, Eliseo. She's lucky to have made a friend in you.
speaker: Millscar
content: You're a good man, Eliseo. She's lucky to have made a friend in you.

raw: [name="Millscar"]Get ready. You could be leaving at any time.
speaker: Millscar
content: Get ready. You could be leaving at any time.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]You either die a hero, or you live long enough to see yourself become the villain.
speaker: Eliseo
content: You either die a hero, or you live long enough to see yourself become the villain.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]Did you ever think you'd turn out this way?
speaker: Eliseo
content: Did you ever think you'd turn out this way?

speaker: Millscar
content: Why ask just me?

raw: [name="Millscar"]Countless heroes lived through the war. From the most radiant of them to those that none remember. I too am curious as to how they will change in the face of reality.
speaker: Millscar
content: Countless heroes lived through the war. From the most radiant of them to those that none remember. I too am curious as to how they will change in the face of reality.

raw: Lying down amidst the meadow, the soldier senses a slight itch. The cold wind blows at the stalks of grass, and their tips tickle her face.
content: Lying down amidst the meadow, the soldier senses a slight itch. The cold wind blows at the stalks of grass, and their tips tickle her face.

raw: Is this what the land of the dead is like? She opens her eyes and sees someone most unexpected.
content: Is this what the land of the dead is like? She opens her eyes and sees someone most unexpected.

speaker: Diane
content: Huh—Wha—?!

speaker: Eliseo
content: You're awake.

speaker: Diane
content: You—

raw: [name="Eliseo"]It's me, Eliseo. You shouldn't just go off on your own to do dangerous stuff without a word, Diane.
speaker: Eliseo
content: It's me, Eliseo. You shouldn't just go off on your own to do dangerous stuff without a word, Diane.

speaker: Diane
content: I-I remember standing atop the gallows...

raw: [name="Eliseo"]You're dead, at least to those who witnessed the execution.
speaker: Eliseo
content: You're dead, at least to those who witnessed the execution.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]Before we left, I asked the people at Rhodes Island to give you the once-over. It's not looking too good.
speaker: Eliseo
content: Before we left, I asked the people at Rhodes Island to give you the once-over. It's not looking too good.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]A lot of your major organs have already begun to crystallize. In other words, Originium is replacing those organs.
speaker: Eliseo
content: A lot of your major organs have already begun to crystallize. In other words, Originium is replacing those organs.

raw: [name="Diane"]So... I'm not dead? Am I lucky or unlucky?
speaker: Diane
content: So... I'm not dead? Am I lucky or unlucky?

raw: [name="Eliseo"]I'm not sure if the Speaker knew about this beforehand...
speaker: Eliseo
content: I'm not sure if the Speaker knew about this beforehand...

raw: [name="Diane"]So it was Vina who let me go? That's rather foolish of her.
speaker: Diane
content: So it was Vina who let me go? That's rather foolish of her.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]To tell you the truth, I really don't get some of you people. *sigh* Sorry, Diane. I'm afraid you can't go back to Londinium.
speaker: Eliseo
content: To tell you the truth, I really don't get some of you people. *sigh* Sorry, Diane. I'm afraid you can't go back to Londinium.

raw: Only now does she realize they are no longer in Londinium. She sees the tell-tale giant tracks laid down by the nomadic city not too far off in the distance.
content: Only now does she realize they are no longer in Londinium. She sees the tell-tale giant tracks laid down by the nomadic city not too far off in the distance.

raw: Just ahead of them, Sarkaz children run around in the meadow, waving at her as they pass.
content: Just ahead of them, Sarkaz children run around in the meadow, waving at her as they pass.

raw: Most displaced Sarkaz have lost the light in their eyes to confusion. They can go anywhere, but nowhere can they call home.
content: Most displaced Sarkaz have lost the light in their eyes to confusion. They can go anywhere, but nowhere can they call home.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]I'll be taking you to Columbia, Diane. I might be able to do more for you there.
speaker: Eliseo
content: I'll be taking you to Columbia, Diane. I might be able to do more for you there.

speaker: Diane
content: Alright then. Columbia, eh...?

raw: [name="Diane"]I still remember saying that if I get the chance, I'd love to see the place you keep talking about.
speaker: Diane
content: I still remember saying that if I get the chance, I'd love to see the place you keep talking about.

raw: [name="Diane"]How far are we from Columbia, Eliseo?
speaker: Diane
content: How far are we from Columbia, Eliseo?

raw: [name="Eliseo"]Well, still very far away. Let me get out my map—
speaker: Eliseo
content: Well, still very far away. Let me get out my map—

raw: [name="Diane"]Will I be able to make it there in my condition? Walking the whole way?
speaker: Diane
content: Will I be able to make it there in my condition? Walking the whole way?

raw: [name="Diane"]...I see. Could you promise me one thing, Eliseo?
speaker: Diane
content: ...I see. Could you promise me one thing, Eliseo?

raw: [name="Eliseo"]I know what you're going to ask, Diane.
speaker: Eliseo
content: I know what you're going to ask, Diane.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]When the day comes, I'll bring you home. I'll bring you back to Londinium.
speaker: Eliseo
content: When the day comes, I'll bring you home. I'll bring you back to Londinium.

raw: [name="Eliseo"]I'm rather curious myself as to how much the city would have changed by the time we return.
speaker: Eliseo
content: I'm rather curious myself as to how much the city would have changed by the time we return.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="The day we went back to the gym and got drunk, I had a dream.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: The day we went back to the gym and got drunk, I had a dream.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nIn that dream, there was a tomb, all dressed up to the nines. Our names were carved onto the plaques inside it—",block = true)]
text: \nIn that dream, there was a tomb, all dressed up to the nines. Our names were carved onto the plaques inside it—

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="'Morgan', Kate Morrigan... 'Indra', Hannah Jackson", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: 'Morgan', Kate Morrigan... 'Indra', Hannah Jackson

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n'Dagda', Isabelle Montague... 'Baird', Brigit Lucan",block = true)]
text: \n'Dagda', Isabelle Montague... 'Baird', Brigit Lucan

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Outside the tomb, there was a blazing carriage, and atop it sat a golden lion. He was calling my name.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: Outside the tomb, there was a blazing carriage, and atop it sat a golden lion. He was calling my name.
\nVina Victoria.

speaker: Morgan
content: Mmfh... Vina...

raw: [name="Morgan"]...A blanket? Who put this blanket on me?
speaker: Morgan
content: ...A blanket? Who put this blanket on me?

raw: [name="Morgan"]Urgh, my head hurts real bad. What time is it—
speaker: Morgan
content: Urgh, my head hurts real bad. What time is it—

raw: [name="???"]Morgan, didn't I tell you not to drink like a sodding wino all the time?
content: Morgan, didn't I tell you not to drink like a sodding wino all the time?

raw: [name="???"]Hah, considering how wild Hannah and the rest can get, shouldn't you be looking after them?
content: Hah, considering how wild Hannah and the rest can get, shouldn't you be looking after them?

speaker: Morgan
content: Eh...? Vina? Vina!

raw: Morgan nimbly launches herself out of the sofa, leaping over the short table to throw herself at Vina.
content: Morgan nimbly launches herself out of the sofa, leaping over the short table to throw herself at Vina.

speaker: Morgan
content: Vina, you came over!

speaker: Morgan
content: I thought... I thought...

speaker: Vina
content: You thought what?

speaker: Morgan
content: Why didn't you wake me, Hannah?!

raw: [name="Indra"]Weren't you yapping and yowling yesterday about how she definitely wasn't coming?
speaker: Indra
content: Weren't you yapping and yowling yesterday about how she definitely wasn't coming?

raw: [name="Indra"]Look at you. You turned out the most excited out of all of us.
speaker: Indra
content: Look at you. You turned out the most excited out of all of us.

speaker: Morgan
content: No I'm not!

speaker: Indra
content: Stubborn prick.

speaker: Vina
content: Quiet down, Morgan. Dagda's still asleep.

speaker: Dagda
content: (Mmph...)

raw: The one resting her head atop Indra's lap twitches her ears, still lost within a lovely drunken dream.
content: The one resting her head atop Indra's lap twitches her ears, still lost within a lovely drunken dream.

raw: [name="Delphine"]Seems like Dagda drank the most out of you lot. I tidied up a lot of empty bottles.
speaker: Delphine
content: Seems like Dagda drank the most out of you lot. I tidied up a lot of empty bottles.

raw: [name="Delphine"]She must've been in a real rotten mood, Vina.
speaker: Delphine
content: She must've been in a real rotten mood, Vina.

speaker: Vina
content: Sorry.

raw: [name="Vina"]I just hope I'm not too late.
speaker: Vina
content: I just hope I'm not too late.

speaker: Morgan
content: Well of course you're not!

speaker: Indra
content: Wasn't what you said yesterday, Morgan.

speaker: Morgan
content: (Shut it, Hannah!)

speaker: Morgan
content: Welcome home, Vina!

raw: [name="Vina"]I was really hoping to pop in earlier, but there's simply far too much to handle over at Parliament.
speaker: Vina
content: I was really hoping to pop in earlier, but there's simply far too much to handle over at Parliament.

speaker: Morgan
content: Then... How'd you...

raw: [name="Vina"]I'm afraid I've given Horn another headache to deal with.
speaker: Vina
content: I'm afraid I've given Horn another headache to deal with.

raw: [name="Vina"]I suspect she'll only just have discovered I slipped away—
speaker: Vina
content: I suspect she'll only just have discovered I slipped away—

raw: [name="Indra"]Then does that mean you need to head back?
speaker: Indra
content: Then does that mean you need to head back?

raw: [name="Vina"]I can't run away from my responsibilities.
speaker: Vina
content: I can't run away from my responsibilities.

raw: [name="Vina"]But I owe you all an apology.
speaker: Vina
content: But I owe you all an apology.

speaker: Morgan
content: Vina, you don't need to—

speaker: Dagda
content: Eh? Siege? Vina!

speaker: Dagda
content: How long've I been asleep?!

speaker: Indra
content: Relax, Vina's only just arrived back.

speaker: Delphine
content: That knife hanging on the wall—

speaker: Morgan
content: It's hers. Cador brought it back.

speaker: Delphine
content: Cador?!

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Vina never brought up having to head back the whole day, but we all knew—", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: Vina never brought up having to head back the whole day, but we all knew—

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThat the Siege Vina, the boss of the Glasgow Gang, the ever-victorious king of the 'Slobberknocker', and (one of) my best friend(s) could leave us at any moment.",block = true)]
text: \nThat the Siege Vina, the boss of the Glasgow Gang, the ever-victorious king of the 'Slobberknocker', and (one of) my best friend(s) could leave us at any moment.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nSo I was loathe to lose a single moment where I could tell Vina about all the changes in Norport that she hadn't had the chance to see yet...",block = true)]
text: \nSo I was loathe to lose a single moment where I could tell Vina about all the changes in Norport that she hadn't had the chance to see yet...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Cador, Mr. Lane, the video shop...", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: Cador, Mr. Lane, the video shop...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe reworked port, the rebuilt stores, a handful of old friends who rushed home after hearing the news...",block = true)]
text: \nThe reworked port, the rebuilt stores, a handful of old friends who rushed home after hearing the news...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nOf course, who could forget the inexperienced little buggers who wanted to 'take over our gym'. After Vina beat them all to kingdom come with a smile on her face, they apologized by way of a few cartons of beer, and said they wanted to join us—",block = true)]
text: \nOf course, who could forget the inexperienced little buggers who wanted to 'take over our gym'. After Vina beat them all to kingdom come with a smile on her face, they apologized by way of a few cartons of beer, and said they wanted to join us—

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Seems like Norport's forgotten about us, but I don't think that's such a bad thing.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: Seems like Norport's forgotten about us, but I don't think that's such a bad thing.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe war really was over.",block = true)]
text: \nThe war really was over.

speaker: Morgan
content: Do you still remember this place?

raw: [name="Vina"]Why don't we get back to our little games, see who's fastest this time around?
speaker: Vina
content: Why don't we get back to our little games, see who's fastest this time around?

raw: Before Vina has even finished speaking, Indra has already begun to set off.
content: Before Vina has even finished speaking, Indra has already begun to set off.

speaker: Morgan
content: Hannah, you lousy cheat!

raw: [name="Indra"]She didn't say nothing about a countdown. I'm still the champ here!
speaker: Indra
content: She didn't say nothing about a countdown. I'm still the champ here!

speaker: Dagda
content: Hmph.

raw: [name="Dagda"]You've gotten slower ever since your injury, Hannah.
speaker: Dagda
content: You've gotten slower ever since your injury, Hannah.

speaker: Indra
content: Say that after you've caught up.

speaker: Delphine
content: Eh? Wha—?

speaker: Delphine
content: What's going on? Wait for me!

speaker: Vina
content: Don't fall behind, Delphine! Follow me!

raw: [name="Morgan"]Hear that, Del? You're a real slowpoke!
speaker: Morgan
content: Hear that, Del? You're a real slowpoke!

raw: Several figures speed through the streets, and a few workers heading home after work give an inquisitive glance at the brash crew.
content: Several figures speed through the streets, and a few workers heading home after work give an inquisitive glance at the brash crew.

raw: They can't quite seem to remember who this gang is—
content: They can't quite seem to remember who this gang is—

raw: 'Must be another bunch of outsiders just arrived at Norport. Maybe.'
content: 'Must be another bunch of outsiders just arrived at Norport. Maybe.'

raw: High above the gaps between the factories, the Glasgow Gang return to a favorite spot of theirs.
content: High above the gaps between the factories, the Glasgow Gang return to a favorite spot of theirs.

raw: Here, they can look down upon the squatting factories, and look out at the Shard's pointed peak over at Central.
content: Here, they can look down upon the squatting factories, and look out at the Shard's pointed peak over at Central.

raw: It was here that they started, and it was here that they left home. After a long period of wandering about, they have finally returned to this familiar place.
content: It was here that they started, and it was here that they left home. After a long period of wandering about, they have finally returned to this familiar place.
But—

speaker: Indra
content: I left a glass for Baird.

raw: [name="Indra"]Sure you don't want a tipple, Dagda?
speaker: Indra
content: Sure you don't want a tipple, Dagda?

raw: [name="Dagda"]No thank you. I'm not going to embarrass myself in front of Vina again.
speaker: Dagda
content: No thank you. I'm not going to embarrass myself in front of Vina again.

raw: [name="Morgan"]I'll give your share to her, then.
speaker: Morgan
content: I'll give your share to her, then.

speaker: Morgan
content: Just fruit juice for you, Del?

raw: [name="Delphine"]Don't call me that. I'm still not too used to alcohol.
speaker: Delphine
content: Don't call me that. I'm still not too used to alcohol.

raw: [name="Dagda"]Suit yourself. I'll keep watch over you all.
speaker: Dagda
content: Suit yourself. I'll keep watch over you all.

raw: [name="Indra"]Hell yeah! Finally, the part where we can start bloody drinking!
speaker: Indra
content: Hell yeah! Finally, the part where we can start bloody drinking!

speaker: Indra
content: To Baird! To the Glasgow Gang!

speaker: Everyone
content: To Baird! To the Glasgow Gang!

speaker: Indra
content: To Rhodes Island! To the Exemplars!

raw: [name="Delphine"]To everyone who fought in the war!
speaker: Delphine
content: To everyone who fought in the war!

raw: [name="Morgan"]And, and, to all those who risked their lives coming home!
speaker: Morgan
content: And, and, to all those who risked their lives coming home!

raw: [name="Vina"]To all those who live, and who left... To all those still by our side...
speaker: Vina
content: To all those who live, and who left... To all those still by our side...

raw: [name="Vina"]To all those who shed blood and tears, to all those who struggle in darkness and in pain...
speaker: Vina
content: To all those who shed blood and tears, to all those who struggle in darkness and in pain...

speaker: Vina
content: ...To Victoria.

speaker: Everyone
content: To Victoria!

raw: There is no need for sorrow. The living engrave the moment in their memories, while those who left leave behind their hopes and dreams.
content: There is no need for sorrow. The living engrave the moment in their memories, while those who left leave behind their hopes and dreams.

raw: The fowlbeasts croon as they spiral overhead, echoing their words.
content: The fowlbeasts croon as they spiral overhead, echoing their words.

speaker: Indra
content: You heading off too, Delphine?

raw: [name="Delphine"]Only for a short while. I need to go back to Lynncardine. Shearer will come along to recuperate.
speaker: Delphine
content: Only for a short while. I need to go back to Lynncardine. Shearer will come along to recuperate.

raw: [name="Morgan"]If you ever get real fed up of those lousy bastards, you can always come back here.
speaker: Morgan
content: If you ever get real fed up of those lousy bastards, you can always come back here.

speaker: Morgan
content: This is your home too.

raw: [name="Delphine"]Of course I will! I promised Vina, after all.
speaker: Delphine
content: Of course I will! I promised Vina, after all.

raw: [name="Dagda"]If there's ever a day you feel like it's all too much for you, Vina—
speaker: Dagda
content: If there's ever a day you feel like it's all too much for you, Vina—

speaker: Vina
content: I'll come back.

raw: [name="Vina"]But I think I can handle it.
speaker: Vina
content: But I think I can handle it.

raw: [name="Vina"]I hope the Londiniers can live in peace and happiness, and I hope that everyone can live their best lives. It's what they deserve.
speaker: Vina
content: I hope the Londiniers can live in peace and happiness, and I hope that everyone can live their best lives. It's what they deserve.

raw: [name="Vina"]Everyone should be like us. Smiling, without a tear in sight or an empty belly to be heard.
speaker: Vina
content: Everyone should be like us. Smiling, without a tear in sight or an empty belly to be heard.

raw: [name="Vina"]I'm not going to let everything we've accomplished go to waste.
speaker: Vina
content: I'm not going to let everything we've accomplished go to waste.

raw: [name="Vina"]If someone tries to take it from us, I'll be fighting back.
speaker: Vina
content: If someone tries to take it from us, I'll be fighting back.

raw: [name="Vina"]Just like how we looked after this place back then.
speaker: Vina
content: Just like how we looked after this place back then.

speaker: Morgan
content: Vina...

raw: [name="Vina"]Vina, Alexandrina, either's fine. There's no difference the way I see it. No?
speaker: Vina
content: Vina, Alexandrina, either's fine. There's no difference the way I see it. No?

speaker: Indra
content: *burp*—

raw: [name="Vina"]If Baird were here, that's what she'd want me to do.
speaker: Vina
content: If Baird were here, that's what she'd want me to do.

speaker: Baird
content: You're right, Vina.

speaker: Baird
content: I really do hope so...

raw: [name="Baird"]To the Glasgow Gang. To all of you.
speaker: Baird
content: To the Glasgow Gang. To all of you.

speaker: Baird
content: Welcome home, everyone.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Vina left us on the morning of the day after. She didn't let us see her off. Maybe she didn't want to wake us.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: Vina left us on the morning of the day after. She didn't let us see her off. Maybe she didn't want to wake us.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nIn truth, we were all awake. I watched her change into those clothes I was never fond of, and walk off on her lonesome towards Central Londinium.",block = true)]
text: \nIn truth, we were all awake. I watched her change into those clothes I was never fond of, and walk off on her lonesome towards Central Londinium.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nI hope Vina managed to get a real good night's sleep, the best she's had in a long while. After all, it's only when she's at home that she doesn't need to think about anything.",block = true)]
text: \nI hope Vina managed to get a real good night's sleep, the best she's had in a long while. After all, it's only when she's at home that she doesn't need to think about anything.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I spent the entire night writing down everything that happened the day Vina came home, no matter how big or small.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I spent the entire night writing down everything that happened the day Vina came home, no matter how big or small.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I believe there will come a day that you, Vina, will read these words I wrote down.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I believe there will come a day that you, Vina, will read these words I wrote down.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThey might not be of too much use, but they can help you remember some of the more easily-forgotten things.",block = true)]
text: \nThey might not be of too much use, but they can help you remember some of the more easily-forgotten things.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nVina, do you still remember that dream I wrote about earlier?",block = true)]
text: \nVina, do you still remember that dream I wrote about earlier?

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="In that dream, there was a tomb, all dressed up to the nines. Our names were carved onto the plaques inside it—", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: In that dream, there was a tomb, all dressed up to the nines. Our names were carved onto the plaques inside it—

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nOutside the tomb, there was a blazing carriage, and atop it sat a golden lion. He was calling my name.",block = true)]
text: \nOutside the tomb, there was a blazing carriage, and atop it sat a golden lion. He was calling my name.
\nVina Victoria.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I dreamt I was you.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I dreamt I was you.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nI dreamt of a time I was all old and withered, some afternoon decades after I lost touch with my Glasgow friends...",block = true)]
text: \nI dreamt of a time I was all old and withered, some afternoon decades after I lost touch with my Glasgow friends...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nI walked into the tomb that 'Siege' built for the gang.",block = true)]
text: \nI walked into the tomb that 'Siege' built for the gang.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I cherish that unforgettable memory that is no longer mine. I cherish the tale that started in Norport.", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I cherish that unforgettable memory that is no longer mine. I cherish the tale that started in Norport.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nVina, from the day you put on those clothes, I knew...",block = true)]
text: \nVina, from the day you put on those clothes, I knew...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nIn the end, you walk alone. You have no choice but to walk alone.",block = true)]
text: \nIn the end, you walk alone. You have no choice but to walk alone.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I'm sorry. There's no way for us to help you, or to stay by your side...", x=300,y=270, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I'm sorry. There's no way for us to help you, or to stay by your side...

text: \nBut I wanted to let you know, we will always be here.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe Glasgow Gang will always be here.",block = true)]
text: \nThe Glasgow Gang will always be here.
